newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela seeks approval for $315 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela seeks approval for $315 mln bond issue.

text.p: The Venezuelan government has asked Congress for approval to make a $315 million sovereign par bond issue to raise funds for investment in the Armed Forces, according to a document obtained by Reuters Wednesday.

The document, sent to the Chamber of Deputies Finance Committee by Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar, said the bond issue would be led by ING Barings (US) Securities and would have a maturity of 10 years.
The coupon on the issue would be 9.31 percent and it would be issued on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange, the document said.
The bond issue has already been approved by the Central Bank, it added.
